beats.text: In February 2025, one asteroid had a three percent chance of hitting Earth.
beats.header: 2024 YR4 · 3.1% · a record for its size
beats.anchor: 1 in 32: highest ever recorded for its size

beats.text: It's about sixty metres wide. Headlines called it a city killer.
beats.header: 60 m ≈ a football pitch · pictured: Bennu
beats.anchor: about the width of a football pitch

beats.text: Then more telescopes tracked it, and Earth dropped out of the danger zone completely.
But the Moon was next in line, with a four percent chance.
Then Webb spotted it one last time. It will pass almost twenty three thousand kilometres from the Moon's centre.
So in 2032 it hits nothing at all, even though
beats.header: Miss confirmed: Moon and Earth both safe
